market_context.rationale_en: Technical indicators clearly show medium-term downtrend. KOSPI is down 6.22% and KOSDAQ down 14.44% on a 20-day basis, with 60-day maximum drawdowns exceeding −30% indicating strong downward pressure. Sustained foreign investor selling (−99,863 shares over 5 days for held position) combined with global dollar strength is intensifying emerging market capital outflows. While a 5-day rebound is underway, its sustainability is weak within a high-volatility bear regime (60-day annualized volatility exceeding +50%). Halting new purchases on the next trading day and awaiting market stabilization is appropriate.
